qiraat.reason: Recitation file names already write a riwayah by a short code (`As-Hf`), from the MARQOUM naming manual that the Raqim tool applies. Registering the 20 codes makes both forms valid in a file name, the short code and the full code, and keeps the mapping in one place instead of in every consumer. The code stays the one code name (rule 001); a short code is a recorded second form, not a code name (rule 008) and not an alternative spelling (rule 044). Only riwayahs take one: the manual's `Kh` stands for both the rawi `khalaf` and the qiraah `khalaf_al_ashir`, and a name belongs to one entry. `Ik-Ba` follows the manual's current page; Raqim 1.0.5 still writes `Ik-Bz`.

note.en: `short_code` was added on 26 November 2026. It is the short form of a riwayah's code that recitation file names use: `As-Hf` and `hafs_an_asim` name the same riwayah. It may stand for the code where a name has to stay short ([Clear names](/docs/terms/standard#section-93)).
note.ar: أُضيف العمود `short_code` في 26 نوفمبر 2026، وفيه الرمز المختصر للرواية كما يُكتب في أسماء ملفات التلاوات: `As-Hf` و`hafs_an_asim` اسمان للرواية نفسها. ويجوز أن يقوم مقام الاسم البرمجي حيث يلزم أن يبقى الاسم قصيرًا ([الأسماء الواضحة](/ar/docs/terms/standard#section-93)).
